about: Tracks: each a line of skills that ends in a project you could do on the bench or on site. A stop is a lesson, named as what you can do once it is learned. The map is drawn from this file; the order of the stops is the order to learn them.

tracks.title: Controls: VFD conveyor
tracks.project: Commission a VFD-driven conveyor on the training rig
tracks.counts: HNC units (to map against the specification); CPD record
stops: Work out the currents and voltages in a circuit
Read AC: peak, RMS and frequency
Work out kW, kVA and power factor
Wire and measure three-phase, star and delta
Choose and wire a motor starter
Work out an induction motor's speed and slip
Set a drive up for V/f or vector control
Set a drive's parameters and clear its faults

tracks.title: PLC fault-finding
tracks.project: Find three planted faults on a PLC-controlled machine
tracks.counts: HNC units (to map against the specification); CPD record
stops: Explain what a PLC does every scan
Read and write a seal-in rung
Catch a rising or falling edge
Trace an I/O point through the drawings
Find a fault on Profinet or Modbus
Set a drive's parameters and clear its faults

tracks.title: Servo axis
tracks.project: Size and tune a servo axis for a given move
tracks.counts: Your role: motion commissioning; CPD record
stops: Pick a servo motor and amplifier
Plan a trapezoidal or S-curve move
Match the load's inertia to the motor
Size a servo by its RMS torque
Explain P, I and D in a loop
Tune the current, speed and position loops

tracks.title: A-level Pure Maths
tracks.project: Sit a timed past Pure paper
stops: Solve trig equations and use the identities

tracks.title: Instrument loop
tracks.project: Loop-check and tune a 4–20 mA PID loop
tracks.counts: HNC units (to map against the specification); CPD record
stops: Measure temperature with RTDs and thermocouples
Scale an analogue input in the PLC
Explain P, I and D in a loop

tracks.title: Control panel
tracks.project: Inspect and test a panel to BS 7671 and BS EN 60204-1
tracks.counts: HNC units (to map against the specification); CPD record
stops: Size a cable for current and volt drop
Size a transformer and a 24 V supply
Lay out a panel to BS EN 60204-1
